text:
elaine: Kicking off PulseBench kernel-comparison with VegaCorp — goal is an apples-to-apples perf/W and 99p throughput comparison across partner cards. Need a short sync to lock runbook, telemetry schema, and marketplace artifact requirements. Who's available?

samir: I can own the Vega side. What do you want for power telemetry: platform-reported wattage or raw sensor traces? Also list of SKUs we should include.

mike: Platform-reported wattage for the portal, raw sensor traces (INA219 logs) for verification. We'll hand over a python harness so runs are reproducible. Baseline config: seq_len=2048, batch sweep 1..128, token warmup 50.

noah: Make sure we pin kernel + driver exposures. Recommend kernel 5.15 + driver 525.x for reproducibility on our runners. Also call out fan profiles and thermal limits in the runbook. We'll need KMS access for private s3 runners.

elaine: Short action list: @samir provide board SW image + fan profiles; @mike share harness + perf config (yaml); @noah grant runner creds + telemetry endpoints. Target: dry run next Tue 10am PT. :calendar:

samir: Sending SKU + firmware matrix by EOD. Heads up: one SKU shows ~8% worse perf/W at 85% TDP vs default, will note in spreadsheet.

anya: From GTM side — please flag any non-disclosure constraints on raw traces. If dry run looks good, we want a 2-week comms window for a joint marketplace announcement and co-branded datasheet.

bench-bot: New run created -> repo: pulsebench/vega/pb-veg-v1; artifact id: pb-veg-v1-20260321. Command: `./run.sh --artifact pb-veg-v1-20260321 --mode smoke`

mike: Metrics we must capture: tokens/s (p50/p95/p99), avg power (W), energy per token (mJ/token), kernel latency and scheduler counters. I'll add telemetry mapping to the harness and a postproc script that emits CSV + JSON.

elaine: Great. I'll draft the runbook and push to the private docs link and send calendar invite. Link (private): https://redwood.internal/docs/pulsebench-runbook. Meeting Tue 10am PT. Thanks all — short and focused. :tada:
